subject: Deployment options & isolation requirements for Astra Health
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment options & isolation requirements for Astra Health

Hi Priya — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Call recap:
- Primary objective: run clinical-document summarization and patient Q&A across multiple products with strict latency and P99 SLOs (target: 250–350ms token latency for interactive flows).
- Data sensitivity: PHI in transcripts; need audit logs + KMS integration.
- Expected steady-state: ~450 concurrent users (burst to 1.2k/day), roughly 12M tokens/month.
- Current concern: noisy-neighbor interference on shared endpoints impacting tail latency; procurement and security want clear isolation options.

Options we discussed (short):
1) Hosted API (shared) — fastest to go live, transparent perf for typical workloads, but shared tenancy can have tail variability. Good for early ramp or non-critical workflows.
2) Dedicated capacity — reserved GPU pool with predictable throughput, selectable instance types, can meet tighter P99s by controlling placement and sizing.
3) Private (VPC/on-prem) — full network isolation, customer-managed VPC + on-prem package available for strict compliance.

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Can you confirm whether all workloads will require PHI-level isolation, or if we can pilot on non-PHI traffic initially? (answer will drive whether Dedicated or Private is appropriate)
- We'll pull a short isolation & SLO evidence pack (latency heatmaps, noisy-neighbor risk matrix) and a Dedicated trial plan — sending as attachments.
- Proposed next meeting: Tech deep-dive with Rishi + infra on Wed 2026-11-10 at 10:00am PT. Please confirm availability.

I've attached a one-page Dedicated trial plan and an isolation matrix for your security team. If helpful I can also prepare a short benchmark showing P99 tails for a 4-GPU Dedicated pool vs Hosted baseline for your expected request profile.

Thanks —
Monica
Monica Patel | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0184

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-trial-plan.pdf (4 pages), sla-and-isolation-matrix.xlsx (workbook)

From: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@astrahealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Deployment options & isolation requirements for Astra Health

Thanks Monica — useful summary. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

1) PHI handling: we cannot expose PHI in shared tenancy for core patient-facing experiences. That said, we could consider an initial pilot on de-identified transcripts if that speeds time-to-value.
2) Tail latency sensitivity: our clinicians reported occasional >700ms responses in a hosted trial last quarter — that is unacceptable for triage use-cases. We need a clear P99 guarantee or a mitigation plan.
3) Compliance: our security team needs SOC2 evidence and network controls (VPC peering or private connectivity). Can you share what telemetry/audit logs are available for Private and Dedicated?

Also looping Amit Shah (infra lead) on procurement side — he may have bandwidth to join the tech deep-dive.

—Priya

Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment options & isolation requirements for Astra Health

Priya — great notes. Short answers and what we'll bring to the tech call: 

PHI & tenancy:
- If PHI must never touch shared multitenant hosts, Dedicated or Private are the right paths. Dedicated gives logical isolation (reserved GPU pools) and can be configured with customer-managed keys (KMS). Private (VPC/on-prem) is required for air-gapped or on-prem mandates.

P99 & mitigation:
- We can run a short Dedicated trial configured to match your request size and sequence distributions; our benchmarks show P99 improvements of ~2–3x vs baseline shared for similar profiles when properly sized and pinned. We'll include latency heatmaps in the evidence pack.

Telemetry & compliance artifacts we'll bring:
- SOC2 summary + control mapping (PDF)
- Audit log samples and retention options (we support export to your SIEM via S3/CloudWatch ingestion)
- Network options: VPC peering, PrivateLink, and on-prem connectors documented.

Proposed next steps (for the call on Wed 2026-11-10):
- Rishi will run a quick sizing exercise during the meeting (expected CPU/GPU profile + estimated pool size)
- Marissa will walk through the isolation matrix and mitigation playbook for noisy neighbors
- We'll agree on a scope for a 2-week Dedicated trial (traffic profile, SLA targets, success criteria)

Can you confirm if Amit can join and whether de-identified pilot data is acceptable to run the trial sooner?

Thanks — looking forward.
Monica

Subject: Internal: Astra Health — trial scope & pricing thoughts

Team — internal alignment after Priya's reply: 

Key constraints:
- PHI cannot be on shared hosts for production clinician flows.
- Customer wants firm guidance on sizing to hit ~300ms P99 for interactive sessions.

Suggested trial scope (2 weeks):
- Dedicated 4x A100-equivalent GPUs, pinned, with continuous batching tuned to Astra's avg seq length (we'll confirm during call).
- Collect P50/P95/P99 latency, token throughput, and KV cache hit rate; share dashboards daily.
- Optional: limit pilot to de-identified transcripts if procurement needs delay PHI approval.

Pricing ballpark for trial & ramp: estimated monthly committed cost for Dedicated (4-GPU pool): $XX,XXX — we'll firm this after sizing. Include one-time onboarding fee and 24/7 on-call for SLA coverage during the trial.

Attachments to send to customer after the call: 
- dedicated-trial-plan (pdf)
- sla-and-isolation-matrix.xlsx
- SOC2-summary.pdf

Action items:
- Rishi: prepare quick sizing worksheet and run a sample benchmark on a test pool by Mon 2026-11-08.
- Marissa: adapt isolation matrix to include explicit mitigations for KV cache contention and batch-priority routing.
- Monica: confirm Wed 11/10 10am PT with Priya + Amit; prepare the evidence pack.

Thanks — M
